summary: std/http: ReverseProxy forwards a query that does not parse rebuilt from what parsed, as Go's cleanQueryParams, so the upstream sees only what the rewrite hook saw (GO-2022-1038, GO-2026-4976)
details: ReverseProxy forwards a query that does not parse rebuilt from what parsed, as Go's cleanQueryParams, so the upstream sees only what the rewrite hook saw (GO-2022-1038, GO-2026-4976). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/http, all backends): ReverseProxy forwards a query that does not parse rebuilt from what parsed, as Go's cleanQueryParams, so the upstream sees only what the rewrite hook saw (GO-2022-1038, GO-2026-4976). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
